title: Tough only before his wife
odia:
ଧାଇଁ ନପାରଇ ପାଇକ ଆଗେ
ଟାଣ କରୁଥାଇ ମାଇପ ଆଗେ।
literal_meaning: He cannot rush forward before a soldier, but keeps acting tough before his wife.
meaning_odia: ପାଇକ ଆଗରେ ଧାଇଁ ପାରୁନଥିବା ଲୋକ ମାଇପ ଆଗରେ ଟାଣ ଦେଖାଉଛି—ଏହି ଦୁଇ ପରିସ୍ଥିତିର ଅମେଳ ଏଠାରେ ଅଛି। ଆମ ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ପାଠରେ ବାହାରେ ସାହସ ଦେଖାଇ ନପାରି ଘରେ ପତ୍ନୀଙ୍କ ଆଗରେ କଠୋରତା ଦେଖାଇବାକୁ ଏହା ଉପହାସ କରେ। ଏହି ଚିତ୍ର ପତ୍ନୀଙ୍କୁ ଦମନ କରିବାର ଅଧିକାର ଦିଏନାହିଁ।
explanation: The same person changes his bearing with the person facing him: unable to rush forward before a soldier, forceful before his wife. Our editorial reading targets selective courage and domestic swagger. The contrast makes the show of toughness look less convincing, rather than making it a model of strength.
usage_example: Original imagined example: Someone avoids standing up to an intimidating outsider, then tries to sound commanding at home. A listener recalls the contrast between the soldier and the wife.
cultural_context: The repeated ଆଗେ places two audiences side by side. The source’s colloquial ମାଇପ supplies the domestic setting; its paired structure directs attention to the man’s change of conduct.
